title: Inicio: tus cursos
brief: Home screen (course list) for NOTAZOD at half-screen width (~820px), now that the Campus opens side by side. Fix overlapping header actions, truncated semester badge and names broken letter by letter; reuse the course view style (theme switch, course colors, outline icons).

artboards.title: Lista compacta
artboards.tradeoff: One row per course with color, groups as chips and student count; secondary actions in a ⋯ menu. Densest and closest to the course sidebar; schedule and room only on hover.

artboards.title: Tarjetas por curso
artboards.tradeoff: Responsive cards with color bar, each group's schedule and room visible, and a dashed 'Crear curso' card. Most readable details; fewer courses per screen.

artboards.title: Agenda de la semana
artboards.tradeoff: Starts from today: next class highlighted, a Mon–Fri timetable built from the Campus schedules, and a compact course list below. Most useful day to day; depends on schedules being synced and is the largest change.
